blurb: Guests paddle through a salt marsh ecosystem on calm, protected waters of Swan River. The area is family-friendly with gentle currents and abundant wildlife including swans, herons, egrets, ospreys, ducks, and more. The business has served families for over 40 years as a top destination for outdoor adventures on Cape Cod.
